"""Restore mis-disabled Honor AI sidebar (FloatTasks)."""
from __future__ import annotations

import json
import re
import subprocess
from datetime import datetime
from pathlib import Path

ADB = r"C:\Users\hzq00\Downloads\platform-tools-latest-windows\platform-tools\adb.exe"
SERIAL = "AVNS023705001888"

OUT = Path(r"C:\Users\hzq00\Documents\Codex\2026-08-23\ni-j\work\stage4_sidebar")
LEDGER_OUT = Path(r"C:\Users\hzq00\Documents\Codex\2026-08-23\ni-j\outputs\HONOR_VER_AN10_STAGE3_LEDGER_20260823.tsv")
JOURNAL_OUT = Path(r"C:\Users\hzq00\Documents\Codex\2026-08-23\ni-j\outputs\HONOR_VER_AN10_STAGE3_JOURNAL_20260823.jsonl")


def sh(*args, timeout=40):
    p = subprocess.run([ADB, "-L", "tcp:5038", "-s", SERIAL, *args], capture_output=True, timeout=timeout)
    out = (p.stdout or b"").decode("utf-8", "replace")
    err = (p.stderr or b"").decode("utf-8", "replace")
    return p.returncode, out, err


def enabled(pkg: str) -> str:
    rc, out, err = sh("shell", "dumpsys", "package", pkg)
    m = re.search(r"User 0:.*?enabled=([0-9-]+)", out, re.S)
    return m.group(1) if m else "PARSE"


def setting(ns: str, key: str) -> str:
    rc, out, err = sh("shell", "settings", "get", ns, key)
    return (out or err).strip()


def main() -> None:
    OUT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    ts = datetime.now().isoformat(timespec="seconds")
    before = {
        "enabled": enabled(PKG),
        "float_task_state": setting("secure", "float_task_state"),
        "ai_navigationbar": setting("system", "ai_navigationbar"),
    }
    print("BEFORE", json.dumps(before, ensure_ascii=False))
    if before["enabled"] != "3":
        print("unexpected enabled", before["enabled"])

    rc, out, err = sh("shell", "pm", "enable", "--user", "0", PKG)
    after_enable = enabled(PKG)
    rec = {
        "ts": ts,
        "event": "restore_ai_sidebar_floattasks",
        "package": PKG,
        "enable_rc": rc,
        "enable_stdout": out.strip(),
        "enable_stderr": err.strip(),
        "before": before,
        "after_enabled": after_enable,
    }

    # If Honor dropped the user-visible toggle when the package was disabled,
    # restore the swipe sidebar switch. User reported they used swipe to open it.
    float_state = setting("secure", "float_task_state")
    rec["float_task_state_after_enable"] = float_state
    settings_write = None
    if float_state in ("0", "null", ""):
        rc2, out2, err2 = sh("shell", "settings", "put", "secure", "float_task_state", "1")
        settings_write = {
            "rc": rc2,
            "stdout": out2.strip(),
            "stderr": err2.strip(),
            "after": setting("secure", "float_task_state"),
        }
        rec["float_task_state_restored"] = settings_write

    freeze = json.loads(FREEZE.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    freeze_path_bak = FREEZE.with_name(FREEZE.name + ".bak_before_restore_floattasks")
    if not freeze_path_bak.exists():
        freeze_path_bak.write_text(json.dumps(freeze, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    freeze["enforced_disabled_packages"] = [
        e for e in freeze.get("enforced_disabled_packages", [])
        if (e.get("package") if isinstance(e, dict) else e) != PKG
    ]
    skipped = freeze.get("skipped_wave_b") or {}
    skipped[PKG] = "AI sidebar / swipe FloatTasks; restore after user report"
    freeze["skipped_wave_b"] = skipped
    freeze.setdefault("restored_after_user_report", [])
    if PKG not in [x.get("package") if isinstance(x, dict) else x for x in freeze["restored_after_user_report"]]:
        freeze["restored_after_user_report"].append({
            "package": PKG,
            "reason": "AI迦円生涙隈迦錆嬉蝕",
            "action": "pm enable --user 0",
        })
    n_disabled = len(freeze["enforced_disabled_packages"])
    FREEZE.write_text(json.dumps(freeze, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    rec["freeze_disabled_count"] = n_disabled

    rec["after"] = {
        "enabled": after_enable,
        "float_task_state": setting("secure", "float_task_state"),
        "ai_navigationbar": setting("system", "ai_navigationbar"),
    }
    (OUT / "restore_floattasks.json").write_text(json.dumps(rec, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
    print(json.dumps(rec, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))

    line = f"{ts}\tpm_enable_user\t{PKG}\t{'OK' if after_enable in ('0','1') else 'FAIL'}\tAI sidebar restore before={before['enabled']} after={after_enable} rc={rc} stdout={out.strip()}\n"
    for path in (OUT / "ledger.tsv", LEDGER_OUT):
        if path.exists() or path == OUT / "ledger.tsv":
            if not path.exists():
                path.write_text("ts\taction\tpackage\tresult\tnote\n", encoding="utf-8")
            with path.open("a", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                f.write(line)
    with JOURNAL_OUT.open("a", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        f.write(json.dumps(rec, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")
    with (OUT / "journal.jsonl").open("a", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        f.write(json.dumps(rec, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")

    if after_enable not in ("0", "1"):
        raise SystemExit(f"enable failed, enabled={after_enable}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
